title: The relative Frobenius out of a weakly etale scheme over a characteristic-p base is an isomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a weakly etale morphism U -> X with X of characteristic p, the relative Frobenius F_{U/X} : U -> U x_{X,F_X} X is an isomorphism — the scheme-theoretic expression of the fact that weakly etale rings have trivial purely inseparable directions. The retained proof is written as a three-line assembly from the chapter's weakly etale toolkit (all on the shelf): F_{U/X} is a universal homeomorphism (Varieties, lemma relative-frobenius — the radimmersion-plus-surjective property of relative Frobenius); F_{U/X} is weakly etale because its source and target are schemes weakly etale over X (the target is a base change of U -> X by the absolute Frobenius, and the permanence card lemma weakly-etale-permanence — collected as L16090 — promotes the X-map to weakly etale); the rigidity card lemma weakly-etale-universal-homeomorphism (collected as L16091) turns weakly etale plus universal homeomorphism into isomorphism. Each clause of the three-step deduction names its exact source. Retained author proof at lines 19221-19228.
